items.title: Centene (CNC) Stock Still Looks Undervalued On Its 96% Run
items.summary: Centene has delivered a sharp share price run, and that leaves investors asking whether the current valuation is still grounded in its earnings profile. items.summary: Centene (CNC) is back in focus after subsidiary Health Net moved quickly to support members and healthcare providers affected by the MP18 fire in Humboldt County following California’s State of Emergency declaration.
